change.description: Apply the issuer lifecycle transition notice to the frozen SPACEX world; simulate an explicit observation-time boundary and issuer-entitlement expiration.

sources.description: Issuer notice observed on 17 September 2026 says existing SpaceX PreStocks require swapping before 11:59pm UTC on 12 March 2027 or expire. This is an issuer policy assertion, not independent proof of an IPO, asset value, enforceable rights or a functioning conversion route. The linked successor is intentionally not integrated. Deadline precision is recorded separately.

The demo assumes Active before 2026-09-17T20:00:00Z and TransitionRequired at that instant. This chosen semantic boundary isolates the proposed change; it is NOT the actual IPO time or a proven historical transition time. The issuer states before 11:59pm UTC; this specification conservatively interprets that as an exclusive cutoff at the start of that minute (2027-03-12T23:59:00Z), not an extra minute until midnight. NoIssuerEntitlement means issuer-policy expiration, not zero market value or technical inability to exit.
